lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did Steve have any blood on him at that time?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: What about on his body and his clothes?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) Not that I know of.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: What did he tell you he did to her?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Let’s, stop there for a second now, OK. I want to back up just a bit. I didn’t mean to interrupt. That you sayin’ like what time actually did you get over there now? About?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: So it still about that same time, quarter to seven? (Brendan nods “yes”) Are you sure?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: OK, did you really see those two talking on the on the porch?
